title: 1번: The Changing Meaning of the Period
fullPassage: People often omit the period at the end of sentences in single-sentence text messages, which has influenced the way we perceive periods. In an experiment, participants reading text messages found single sentences with a period less sincere than those without one. This could be due to something called "situational code-switching," which simply means that we change how we talk depending on the social setting. For example, the language that students use in the classroom is different from the language they use on the playground. If they talked to their friends the same way they talked to their teachers, it would probably sound strange. Similarly, a person using periods in text messages can cause feelings of awkwardness, just like someone using formal language in a casual setting.
